landing.title: Task-based equipment selector
landing.subtitle: Enter your task parameters and the tool queries the engineering rule table to recommend a camera, lighting and lens configuration, with the reasoning and the risks to watch.
landing.lockedForGuest: The equipment selector is for internal engineers and approved partners. Sign in with a granted account, or contact the Vision department for direct consulting on your application.
landing.lockedForRegistered: Your account is at the "Registered" level, so this tool is not available yet. Contact the Vision department to have your access upgraded, or to get direct consulting on your application.

task.noFields: This task has no input fields declared. Check the input_fields column on task_types.

form.emptyState: Fill in the parameters on the left and press "Calculate recommendation". Results appear here, including the formulas with your numbers substituted so you can check them.

result.historySaved: Saved to your tool usage history.

users.title: User management
users.subtitle: Grant Member/VIP access to staff and partners. Self-registered accounts default to Registered.
users.selfHint: You cannot change your own access level, to avoid locking yourself out of the admin area.

articles.title: Article management
articles.subtitle: Write bilingual content and set the access level for each article.
articles.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. This becomes the end of the article URL.
articles.publishLabel: Publish (uncheck to save as a draft)

rules.title: Equipment recommendation rules
rules.subtitle: Edit rules here, no code changes needed. A lower priority number wins for each output slot.
rules.invalidStored: The stored condition is malformed, so this rule will not work correctly.
rules.codeHint: Optional, must be unique. Used to refer to the rule in discussion, e.g. MEAS-TELECENTRIC-TOL.
rules.priorityHint: Lower number = higher priority. Baseline rules are usually 100.
rules.conditionHint: Format {"all":[{"field":"...","op":"...","value":...}]}. Use {} for a baseline rule that always matches. Operators: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, nin, exists.
rules.unknownFields: Fields not in the supported list: {fields}. This rule will never match.
rules.fieldsHelpBody: Includes both user-entered parameters and values the engine computes. Thanks to the second group, resolution-based sensor thresholds stay editable here without touching code.
rules.activeLabel: Active (uncheck to disable the rule without deleting it)

errors.notAdmin: You do not have admin permission.
errors.invalidSlug: The slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.invalidPriority: Priority must be a non-negative integer.
errors.cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own access level. Ask another admin, or use the SQL Editor.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: The data could not be loaded. This is usually a lost connection to Supabase or an expired session. Try again; if it persists, report the code below to the engineering team.
